evals.prompt: Here's a photo of our dog Biscuit. Can you turn him into a brick sculpture about 20 cm tall with instructions I can print?
evals.expected_output: Original pet sculpture, previews compared to photo, PASS build, PDF + viewer + BOM, honest notes on recoloured cells and unverified colours.

evals.prompt: Make a 48x48 stud brick mosaic of this sunset photo and give me a BrickLink wanted list.
evals.expected_output: Flat mosaic, limited palette, one structure, BrickLink XML, preview image.

evals.prompt: Design a small brick lighthouse my 7 year old can build, under 400 pieces, with a printable booklet.
evals.expected_output: Kids audience (<= 4 parts/step), under 400 parts, hollow shell, PASS, PDF.

evals.prompt: Build me a brick version of Darth Vader's helmet with instructions.
evals.expected_output: Declines the third-party character in one sentence and offers an original helmet design; proceeds on acceptance.

evals.prompt: I have this model.json from last time; the base keeps tipping. Fix it and regenerate the book.
evals.expected_output: Reads model/design, widens base or adds stand, com_margin_mm >= 3, regenerated outputs.

evals.prompt: Export my castle design to LDraw so I can open it in Studio, and tell me how many parts it needs.
evals.expected_output: Builds design, returns .ldr with steps and part count/lots, notes unverified combos.
